title: Young India Fellowship (Class of 2028)
about: Ashoka University's one-year interdisciplinary fellowship for graduates, with every Class of 2028 Fellow partially or fully funded. Round 1 priority deadline is 29 November 2026; later round deadlines are still to be announced.
requirements: Graduates; final-year undergraduates completing their degree by summer 2027 are also eligible
Apply only once per admissions cycle and in only one round
Applications reviewed on a rolling basis; priority-deadline applications reviewed first
card_alt: Card for the Young India Fellowship (Class of 2028) at Ashoka University, India, with a Round 1 priority deadline of 29 Nov 2026. The photo shows the Taj Mahal in Agra, India, under a sunlit blue sky, framed by its minarets and rows of cypress trees.
